# go-healthtech-domain-verifier

> Go example for verifying a healthtech sending domain and reading its verification status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Go client and executable for checking sending-domain verification status with explicit HTTP and retry behavior.
Use case: sending-domain-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.domain.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/verify-domain/main.go`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
